requirements.description: The main cooling fan MUST activate within 1000 ms when the core temperature exceeds 30.0°C.
If the temperature stays above 45.0°C for >= 5000 ms, the system MUST initiate an emergency shutdown.
The fan speed should feel appropriate for the noise level of the environment.
When the temperature drops below 25.0°C, the fan MUST deactivate within 500 ms to conserve power.
The system SHALL log a warning if the secondary sensor reading differs from the primary by more than 5.0°C for > 2000 ms.
